page.title: 名詞も動詞も、形容詞になれる

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、名詞・現在分詞・過去分詞が名詞の前で形容詞のように働く仕組みを扱う。名詞は用途や分野、-ing形は対象自身の動きや進行、過去分詞は受けた作用や結果状態を表す。
grammarPoints: 名詞＋名詞で後ろの名詞の用途・分野・種類を示す
-ing形は修飾される名詞が行う動作や進行中の変化を表す
過去分詞は修飾される名詞が受けた作用や結果状態を表す
能動関係なら-ing、受動・完了関係なら過去分詞を選ぶ
修飾語の品詞ではなく名詞との意味関係から判断する
visualEvidence: 名詞・-ing・過去分詞の三つの工具箱が同じ名詞レールへ接続している
-ingの矢印は名詞から外へ進み、過去分詞の矢印は名詞へ作用が届く向きを示す
名詞バッジは用途・カテゴリを示すラベルとして描かれている
commonTraps: customer serviceをcustomers serviceのように複数形にする
動作を受けた名詞に-ingを使う
動作をしている名詞に過去分詞を使う
分詞を時制の動詞と取り違えて文の述語を欠く

questions.prompt: All warehouse staff must attend the annual ------- inspection on Monday.
questions.translationJa: 倉庫職員は全員、月曜日の年次安全検査に参加しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞safetyがinspectionの分野・目的を示します。

questions.prompt: The ------- survey showed strong demand for weekend support.
questions.translationJa: 顧客調査では週末支援への強い需要が示されました。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞customerがsurveyの対象分野を前から示します。

questions.prompt: The purchasing team is monitoring ------- material costs.
questions.translationJa: 購買チームは上昇中の材料費を監視しています。
questions.explanationJa: costs自身が上昇しているため現在分詞risingを使います。

questions.prompt: The airline provided meal vouchers to ------- passengers.
questions.translationJa: 航空会社は待っている乗客に食事券を提供しました。
questions.explanationJa: passengers自身が待っているためwaitingが適切です。

questions.prompt: The company plans to enter a rapidly ------- market in Southeast Asia.
questions.translationJa: 会社は東南アジアの急速に発展中の市場へ参入する予定です。
questions.explanationJa: marketが発展の途中にあるためdevelopingを使います。

questions.prompt: Please review the ------- schedule before booking your train.
questions.translationJa: 列車を予約する前に改訂済みの日程を確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: scheduleは改訂された側なので過去分詞revisedです。

questions.prompt: The carrier photographed every ------- carton before unloading it.
questions.translationJa: 運送会社は荷降ろし前に破損した箱をすべて撮影しました。
questions.explanationJa: cartonは損傷を受けた状態なのでdamagedです。

questions.prompt: A ------- executive will advise the board during the transition.
questions.translationJa: 退職した役員が移行期間中に取締役会へ助言します。
questions.explanationJa: retiredは退職という完了した状態を表します。

questions.prompt: Maintenance covered the ------- window until replacement glass arrived.
questions.translationJa: 保守担当は交換用ガラスが届くまで割れた窓を覆いました。
questions.explanationJa: windowは壊された結果状態なのでbrokenを使います。

questions.prompt: The legal team is tracking ------- regulations in all target markets.
questions.translationJa: 法務チームは全対象市場で変化している規制を追跡しています。
questions.explanationJa: regulations自体が変化中なのでchangingが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a report used by the sales department.

choices.A: The selling report includes quarterly forecasts.
choices.B: The sales report includes quarterly forecasts.
choices.C: The sold report includes quarterly forecasts.
choices.D: The report sales includes quarterly forecasts.

questions.translationJa: 売上報告書には四半期予測が含まれます。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞salesがreportの種類を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a room used for employee instruction.

choices.A: The trained room is on the third floor.
choices.B: The train room is on the third floor.
choices.C: The room training is on the third floor.
choices.D: The training room is on the third floor.

questions.translationJa: 研修室は3階にあります。
questions.explanationJa: trainingがroomの用途を示す複合名詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about prices that continue to increase.

choices.A: Increasing fuel prices affected delivery fees.
choices.B: Increased fuel prices are increasing themselves affected delivery fees.
choices.C: Increase fuel prices affected delivery fees.
choices.D: Fuel increased prices affected delivery fees.

questions.translationJa: 上昇する燃料価格が配送料に影響しました。
questions.explanationJa: pricesが増加中なのでincreasingを前置します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a receptionist who is smiling.

choices.A: A smiled receptionist welcomed the visitors.
choices.B: A smile receptionist welcomed the visitors.
choices.C: A smiling receptionist welcomed the visitors.
choices.D: A receptionist smilingly welcomed was the visitors.

questions.translationJa: ほほえんでいる受付担当者が来訪者を迎えました。
questions.explanationJa: receptionist自身がsmileしているためsmilingです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a deadline drawing nearer.

choices.A: The approached deadline requires quick decisions.
choices.B: The approach deadline requires quick decisions.
choices.C: The deadline approachingly requires quick decisions.
choices.D: The approaching deadline requires quick decisions.

questions.translationJa: 迫る期限により迅速な判断が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: deadlineが近づいているためapproachingを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a manual that has been updated.

choices.A: The updating manual contains the new procedure.
choices.B: The updated manual contains the new procedure.
choices.C: The update manual has contained the new procedure.
choices.D: The manual updatedly contains the new procedure.

questions.translationJa: 更新済みのマニュアルには新手順が載っています。
questions.explanationJa: manualは更新された側なのでupdatedです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a badge taken without permission.
questions.translationJa: 警備部門は盗まれた入館証を無効化しました。
questions.explanationJa: badgeは盗まれた側なのでstolenを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an application that is finished.

choices.A: Please submit the completed application by Friday.
choices.B: Please submit the completing application by Friday.
choices.C: Please submit the completion application by Friday.
choices.D: Please completed submit the application by Friday.

questions.translationJa: 記入済みの申請書を金曜日までに提出してください。
questions.explanationJa: applicationは完了させられたものなのでcompletedです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an engineer who no longer works full-time.

choices.A: A retiring engineer already no longer worked reviewed the historical drawings.
choices.B: A retirement engineer reviewed the historical drawings.
choices.C: An engineer retiredly reviewed the historical drawings.
choices.D: A retired engineer reviewed the historical drawings.

questions.translationJa: 退職した技術者が過去の図面を確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: retiredは退職済みという状態を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about doors secured with locks.

choices.A: Only authorized staff may open the locking doors that are already secured.
choices.B: Only authorized staff may open the locked doors.
choices.C: Only authorized staff may open the lock doors.
choices.D: Only authorized staff may lockedly open the doors.

questions.translationJa: 権限のある職員だけが施錠された扉を開けられます。
questions.explanationJa: doorsは施錠された状態なのでlockedです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The research team presented its findings."

choices.A: The team researched only how to make presentations.
choices.B: The findings created a new team.
choices.D: The team responsible for research presented its findings.

questions.translationJa: 調査を担当するチームが調査結果を発表しました。
questions.explanationJa: researchはteamの活動分野を示す名詞修飾です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Employees need a parking permit."

choices.B: Employees need a permit for parking.
choices.C: The parking area needs more employees.
choices.D: Every permit must remain in the parking office.

questions.translationJa: 従業員には駐車許可証が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: parkingがpermitの用途を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Falling demand reduced factory output."

choices.A: Demand rose after the factory reduced prices.
choices.B: The factory produced goods that fell during shipping.
choices.C: Factory output declined because demand was falling.

questions.translationJa: 需要が低下していたため工場生産量が減りました。
questions.explanationJa: fallingはdemandが低下中であることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Waiting customers received an update."

choices.A: Customers who were waiting received an update.
choices.B: Customers waited until the update was canceled.
choices.C: The update required customers to leave.
choices.D: Only customers who had finished waiting were contacted.

questions.translationJa: 待っていた顧客に最新情報が伝えられました。
questions.explanationJa: waitingをwho were waitingという節へ展開しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The firm invested in a growing market."

choices.A: The investment caused the market to close.
choices.B: The firm invested in a market that was expanding.
choices.C: The firm stopped investing after the market grew.
choices.D: The market invested in a growing firm.

questions.translationJa: 会社は拡大中の市場へ投資しました。
questions.explanationJa: growingはmarketの進行中の変化を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The revised contract was sent to Legal."

choices.A: Legal revised a different contract after receiving it.
choices.B: The contract was sent without any revisions.
choices.C: The revision department sent a legal notice.
choices.D: The contract that had been revised was sent to Legal.

questions.translationJa: 改訂された契約書が法務部へ送られました。
questions.explanationJa: revisedは受動関係を持つ過去分詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The damaged parcel was returned."

choices.A: The parcel that had been damaged was returned.
choices.B: The parcel damaged the return equipment.
choices.C: The parcel was returned before any damage occurred.
choices.D: The customer returned a parcel to cause damage.

questions.translationJa: 破損した小包は返送されました。
questions.explanationJa: damagedはparcelが損傷を受けたことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Follow the printed instructions."

choices.A: Print the instructions after following them.
choices.B: Follow the printer to the service desk.
choices.C: Follow the instructions that have been printed.
choices.D: Ignore all instructions displayed on paper.

questions.translationJa: 印刷された手順に従ってください。
questions.explanationJa: printedはinstructionsが印刷された側であることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "A retired director joined the panel."

choices.A: A person who had ended a career as a director joined the panel.
choices.B: A director joined the panel in order to retire it.
choices.C: The current director left the panel permanently.
choices.D: The panel retired before the director arrived.

questions.translationJa: 退職した元取締役が討論会に参加しました。
questions.explanationJa: retiredは職業生活を終えた状態です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The locked cabinet contains spare keys."

choices.A: The cabinet contains locks but no keys.
choices.B: The spare keys locked the cabinet by themselves.
choices.C: The cabinet is open to every visitor.
choices.D: The cabinet that is secured by a lock contains spare keys.

questions.translationJa: 施錠された棚に予備鍵が入っています。
questions.explanationJa: lockedはcabinetの受けた作用と状態を表します。

questions.prompt: The annual audit begins tomorrow. Please place all ------- records in the conference room by noon.
questions.translationJa: 年次監査は明日始まります。財務記録を正午までに会議室へ置いてください。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞financeがrecordsの分野を示します。

questions.prompt: The support team will analyze messages received this quarter. The ------- complaints have already been categorized by topic.
questions.translationJa: 支援チームは今四半期に届いたメッセージを分析します。顧客苦情はすでに話題別に分類されています。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞customerがcomplaintsの発信元・分類を示します。

questions.prompt: The company is opening offices in three new cities. Its ------- network will require additional technical support.
questions.translationJa: 会社は新たに3都市で事務所を開設します。拡大中のネットワークには追加技術支援が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: network自身が拡大しているためexpandingです。

questions.prompt: Call volume is unusually high today. Staff are answering the ------- phones as quickly as possible.
questions.translationJa: 本日は電話件数が非常に多く、職員は鳴っている電話にできるだけ早く応答しています。
questions.explanationJa: phones自身が鳴っているのでringingです。

questions.prompt: Weather forecasts are being updated hourly. Drivers should prepare for rapidly ------- road conditions.
questions.translationJa: 天気予報は毎時更新されています。運転者は急速に変化する道路状況に備えるべきです。
questions.explanationJa: conditionsが変化中なのでchangingを使います。

questions.prompt: The board voted yesterday. The ------- budget authorizes hiring five additional technicians.
questions.translationJa: 取締役会は昨日採決しました。承認済み予算では技術者5人の追加採用が認められています。
questions.explanationJa: budgetは承認された側なのでapprovedです。

questions.prompt: A storm disrupted airport operations. Passengers on the ------- flight received hotel vouchers.
questions.translationJa: 嵐で空港業務が乱れました。遅延した便の乗客にはホテル券が支給されました。
questions.explanationJa: flightは遅延させられた状態なのでdelayedです。

questions.prompt: The records clerk cannot locate two signed forms. The ------- documents must be reported to the supervisor.
questions.translationJa: 記録担当者は署名済み用紙2通を見つけられません。紛失書類は監督者へ報告しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: missingは「所在不明の」という状態を表す分詞形容詞です。

questions.prompt: The museum is reviewing its collection. A ------- curator will help identify items acquired in the 1980s.
questions.translationJa: 博物館は収蔵品を調査中です。退職した学芸員が1980年代取得品の特定を支援します。
questions.explanationJa: curatorは退職済みなのでretiredです。

questions.prompt: The service center finished the repair this morning. The ------- unit will be shipped back to the customer today.
questions.translationJa: サービスセンターは今朝修理を終えました。修理済み装置は本日顧客へ返送されます。
questions.explanationJa: unitは修理された側なのでrepairedです。
